# Scormly

> Scormly is a free, open-source, **local-first** course builder that runs entirely in the
> browser and exports **SCORM 1.2 / 2004** and **cmi5 (xAPI)** packages for any LMS. There is
> no backend and no account — projects and media live in the user's own file system via the
> File System Access API, and packaging happens client-side.

## What it does

- **Block-based course editor** with inline editing, drag-and-drop, insert-a-block-anywhere,
  undo/redo (also straight from the notification after a delete).
- **Blocks:** headings, rich-text paragraphs, lists, callouts, images, galleries, video
  (with optional "require watch" gate and disabled download), audio, embeds, code, tables,
  quotes, a "Continue" gate, a divider, a course outline (links to other lessons), tabs,
  accordions, flashcards, image hotspots, timelines / process steps, sort-the-order and
  fill-in-the-blanks exercises, a branching **dialogue scenario** (classic or
  **chat/messenger** layout with avatars), and **quizzes** (single / multiple / matching,
  with feedback, a passing score, and an optional "show answers" toggle).
- **Exports:** SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, and cmi5 (xAPI, with resume) — generated in the browser
  with JSZip. Quiz objectives, question interactions and progress are reported to the LMS.
  A course check runs before export (empty lessons, missing media, questions without a
  correct answer…). SCORM is verified on SCORM Cloud.
- **Course settings:** completion rule, pass/fail scoring, and a free/linear navigation mode.
- **Help & accessibility:** guided tour, in-app Q&A, a "What's new" page, keyboard shortcuts
  (press ?) and full keyboard support in menus, dialogs and reordering.
- **Installable app (PWA)** from Chrome or Edge; English and Ukrainian interface.
- **Privacy by architecture:** nothing is uploaded, stored remotely, or transmitted.

## For AI agents

Every Scormly project folder contains an `AGENTS.md` that documents `project.json` (the entire
course as JSON) and every block type's `data` shape, so an AI assistant can read, edit, or
author whole courses by editing that single file.

A local MCP server, `scormly-mcp`, connects Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor to a project
folder, with tools to add lessons and blocks, check the course, and export SCORM / cmi5 — still
fully local. Example: `claude mcp add scormly -- npx scormly-mcp --project ./my-course`.
